learningOutcomes.description: Identify types of chemical reactions: combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement, and redox.
Write and balance chemical equations for given reactions.
Explain oxidation and reduction in terms of oxygen gain/loss and electron transfer.
Classify substances as acids, bases, or salts using indicators and pH scale.
Describe the preparation, properties, and uses of common salts: NaOH, baking soda, washing soda, bleaching powder, plaster of Paris.
Compare physical and chemical properties of metals and non-metals.
Explain the reactivity series and its applications in extraction of metals.
Describe the process of corrosion and methods of prevention.
Explain covalent bonding in carbon compounds and the versatile nature of carbon.
Classify hydrocarbons and describe homologous series, nomenclature, and functional groups.
Describe properties and reactions of ethanol and ethanoic acid.
Explain the processes of nutrition in autotrophs and heterotrophs.
Describe the mechanism of respiration, transportation, and excretion in humans and plants.
Differentiate between nervous and hormonal control mechanisms in animals.
Describe reflex arcs, brain structure, and the role of plant hormones in coordination.
Distinguish between asexual and sexual reproduction and list methods of each.
Describe the human reproductive system and the process of fertilisation and development.
Explain Mendel's laws of inheritance using monohybrid and dihybrid crosses.
Describe the mechanism of sex determination in humans and the basis of evolution.
State and apply laws of reflection and refraction; use mirror and lens formulae.
Draw ray diagrams for image formation by mirrors and lenses.

chapters.title: The Human Eye and the Colourful World

learningOutcomes.description: Explain the working of the human eye, defects of vision, and their correction.
Describe dispersion, scattering of light, and atmospheric refraction phenomena.
State and apply Ohm's law; calculate equivalent resistance in series and parallel.
Calculate electrical energy, power consumed, and cost of electricity.
Describe the magnetic field due to a current-carrying conductor, solenoid, and electromagnet.
Explain the working principle of electric motor, generator, and electromagnetic induction.
Explain food chains, food webs, energy flow, and the 10% law.
Describe ozone layer depletion, biological magnification, and waste management.
